gitCommit.subject: feat(canvas): add video support to quick actions and copy-paste (#1349)
gitCommit.body:
feat(canvas): add video support to quick actions and copy-paste (#1349)

* feat(canvas): implement video playback SPIKE prototype

Add VideoNode component for playing videos in Konva canvas:

- Add VideoObject type with playback properties (src, isPlaying, volume, etc.)
- Create VideoNode component using Konva.Image with HTML5 video element
- Implement Konva.Animation loop for continuous frame updates
- Add video tool to toolbar (hotkey: M) with direct file picker
- Support drag, resize, rotate video objects with Transformer
- Add double-click to play/pause with visual overlay indicator
- Fix video deletion by adding isVideoObject checks
- Fix playback by separating play/pause from animation useEffect
- Add video selection state and history tracking
- Add i18n translations for video toolbar button

This is a research SPIKE - not production-ready. Missing:
- S3 upload for persistence
- Playback controls UI panel
- Export handling with video

* docs(spike): add canvas video investigation documentation

Document the SPIKE findings for video playback on canvas including
implementation approach, technical decisions, and next steps.

* Fix/banana in image gen (#1316)

* Enhance generation components to conditionally display settings based on Gemini model. Implement query invalidation for image generations upon completion. Refactor image generation logic to streamline handling of Gemini-specific parameters and improve error handling for illustration generation.

* Refactor GeneratePage and GeneratePageClientRedesign components to remove unused locale prop and associated logic. Streamline the code for improved readability and maintainability.

* Enhance image generation error handling by adding a check for missing requestId. Log an error and update generation status to FAILED if requestId is not present, ensuring robust handling of edge cases in the image generation process.

* Update image generation constants to include new Nano Banana Pro model and implement versioned state migration for drawing canvas. This ensures the default model is set correctly during initial page load, enhancing user experience and maintaining data integrity.

* Refactor configuration components to optimize BaseModelPickerModule usage. Remove duplicate instances in BasicConfigDesktop and BasicConfigMobile, and ensure consistent integration in SidebarConfigArea for improved maintainability and readability.

* Refactor VisualPrompt component to conditionally display warnings based on the base model. Integrate isGeminiModel check for denoising strength conditions, enhancing user feedback and maintaining clarity in the drawing canvas experience.

* Refactor GenerateButton component to improve error handling and streamline loading state management. Ensure proper state updates by moving setIsGenerating and clearPendingGeneration calls to the correct error handling block, enhancing user feedback during the generation process.

* Feat/user analytic (#1324)

* feat(admin): enhance user report and analytics features

- Implement date range filtering in user management and report components, allowing users to specify start and end dates for data retrieval.
- Add new UserSignupStats API endpoint to fetch user signup statistics based on the specified date range.
- Introduce new UI components for displaying user signup statistics, including daily trends, invitation code usage, and generation activity.
- Enhance existing components to support date range selection and integrate with the new API for dynamic data fetching.
- Update translations for new UI elements and ensure consistency across locales.

This update improves the user experience by providing more granular control over data analysis and reporting.

* feat(admin): enhance user signup reporting and management features

- Implemented a new API endpoint to fetch user signups by date, allowing for detailed reporting on user registrations.
- Added a dialog component to display daily signup users, enabling easy navigation to user management.
- Enhanced the daily signup count chart to support date selection, improving user interaction and data analysis.
- Updated translations for new UI elements to ensure consistency across multiple languages.

This update significantly improves the admin interface for managing user signups and enhances the overall user experience by providing more actionable insights.

* feat(generate-button): enhance image generation handling and add loading state (#1325)

- Added `setSelectedImageGeneration` to manage selected image state upon generation completion.
- Updated event handling to include `imageIds` for better image selection.
- Introduced loading toast for image saving feedback.
- Enhanced internationalization by adding 'Saving image' message in English, Japanese, and Chinese locales.
- Improved error handling and state management during image generation process.

Co-authored-by: Beck Chen <bcfchen@gmail.com>

* feat(canvas): add video placeholder with upload controls

Implement video placeholder workflow allowing users to:
- Create empty video placeholders on canvas (320x180 default)
- Drag, resize, rotate placeholders like any canvas object
- Upload video files to selected placeholders via floating UI
- Show liquid glass placeholder design with play icon
- Support i18n for upload button (en, ja, zh-CN, zh-TW)

Changes:
- Add isVideoPlaceholder() utility to distinguish empty from loaded videos
- Create VideoPlaceholderNode component with glass morphism styling
- Add FloatingVideoPlaceholderControls with position tracking
- Update video toolbar to switch to placement mode instead of direct upload
- Add VIDEO_PLACEHOLDER size constants (320x180)
- Implement blob URL cleanup to prevent memory leaks on video deletion
- Update canvas types with placeholder detection logic

This enables a two-step video workflow: place placeholder → upload video,
making it easier to compose multi-video layouts before committing assets.

* refactor(canvas): extract video event handlers and add comprehensive tests

Extract duplicated video drag/transform handlers into reusable functions in
use-canvas-image-events hook, reducing code duplication in gazai-canvas
component. Add comprehensive unit tests for type guards (isTransformable)
and generalized object transform utilities that work across Image, Video,
and Shape types. This enables consistent handling of transformable objects
regardless of type.

- Extract handleVideoDragEnd and handleVideoTransformEnd to use-canvas-image-events
- Update gazai-canvas to use extracted handlers instead of inline code
- Add types.test.ts covering isTransformable type guard for all object types
- Add object-transforms.test.ts with regression tests for image functionality
- Ensure video-specific properties are preserved during transform operations
- All tests passing (567 tests)

* refactor(canvas): use consistent play icon style for video paused state

Replace white play triangle with the same styled Lucide play icon path used
in VideoPlaceholderNode. This improves visual consistency between uploaded
videos and empty video placeholders, providing a cohesive user experience.

- Import Path component from react-konva
- Add PLAY_ICON_PATH constant (matching placeholder implementation)
- Update paused state overlay to use blue Lucide icon instead of white triangle
- Maintain semi-transparent black circle background for visibility

* refactor(canvas): consolidate video placeholder controls into node component

Moves video upload functionality directly into VideoPlaceholderNode by:
- Removing FloatingVideoPlaceholderControls component (160 lines)
- Adding onUploadClick callback to VideoPlaceholderNodeProps
- Implementing drag detection to distinguish click from drag interactions
- Adding comprehensive unit tests for isVideoPlaceholder type guard

Updates canvas rendering to pass onUploadClick handler directly to video nodes,
simplifying component hierarchy. Also hides info panel when video objects are
selected, consistent with placeholder behavior.

* refactor(canvas): update video placeholder styling and default dimensions

- Remove stroke border styling from video placeholder rect
- Update glass morphism fill to catppuccin Lavender (#7287fd99)
- Increase default video placeholder dimensions from 320x180 to 960x540

* feat(canvas): add video frame extraction utility

Add extractVideoFrame utility that captures the first frame of a video
element as a JPEG data URL for use as poster/thumbnail preview.

Features:
- Configurable JPEG quality (default 0.8)
- Optional scaling with maxWidth/maxHeight constraints
- Seek timeout handling for slow videos
- Graceful error handling (returns null on failure)

* feat(canvas): display video first frame as immediate preview

Extract and display the first frame of uploaded videos as a poster image,
providing immediate visual feedback before the video element fully loads.

Changes:
- Extract poster frame during video upload in gazai-canvas.tsx
- Use loadeddata event instead of loadedmetadata for reliable frame availability
- Display poster in VideoNode while video loads
- Show play icon overlay on poster preview

* feat(canvas): implement hover-to-play video interaction

Replace double-click toggle with intuitive hover-based playback:
- Auto-play on mouse enter, pause on mouse leave
- Touch device support with tap-to-toggle (since hover unavailable)
- Maintains onClick handler forwarding for selection behavior

* feat(canvas): add video persistence to S3 with preview generation

Implement complete video upload and persistence workflow for canvas:
- Add uploadVideoToS3 utility for direct S3 uploads with metadata registration
- Create /api/video/register endpoint for database persistence
- Create /api/videos/src endpoint for batch fetching video URLs
- Update S3 presigned URL API to support 500MB video uploads
- Add isUploading and videoId fields to VideoObject type
- Optimize canvas store with batch video URL fetching (avoid N+1)
- Add upload-canvas-video utility to handle upload flow with history tracking
- Extend data/video.ts with helper functions for video retrieval

This enables users to upload videos on canvas with automatic S3 persistence,
Lambda-generated poster images, and full recovery on canvas reload.

* fix(canvas): add selectVideo mock to tests and remove unused import

- Add selectVideo mock to use-panel-object-navigation.test.ts (21 occurrences)
- Add selectVideo mock to use-copy-paste.test.tsx
- Remove unused FloatingVideoPlaceholderControls import from gazai-canvas.tsx

These changes fix TypeScript errors caused by the video feature adding
selectVideo to the SelectionState interface without updating test mocks.

* feat(canvas): add video support to quick actions, copy-paste, download and publish

Add video object handling to FloatingQuickActions with appropriate action
gating (hide image-only actions for video), video download hook with URL
validation and retry logic, video publish hook, and copy-paste video
support. Extract duplicated SelectionItem mapping into shared helpers.

* fix(generate): remove duplicate invalidateQueries call

The same queryClient.invalidateQueries for image-generations was called
twice in succession when a generation completed.

* refactor(canvas): remove cornerRadius from polygon shapes

The corner radius control for polygon shapes is no longer needed.
Removes the property, UI control, rendering logic, i18n keys, and tests.

* fix(canvas): remove unused variables and imports in actions-info and info-panel

Fixes lint errors for unused destructured props and variables that were
no longer referenced after actions moved to floating panels.

---------

Co-authored-by: katie5413 <katie87827@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: Beck Chen <bcfchen@gmail.com>
